text: E no O leptira naafiqiiɓe worɓe ɓen e naafiqiiɓe rewɓe ɓen, e sirkooɓe worɓe ɓen e sirkooɓe rewɓe ɓen, sikkooɓe ɓen woonde Allah wallataa fii diina Makko kan, haa O toowna fii Konngol Makko ngol. Awa yiiloonde lepte wonii e maɓɓe. Allah tikkiranii ɓe sabu yeddugol ɓe ngol sikka Mo ko boni, O woɗɗinii ɓe kadi e yurmeende Makko nden, O hebilanii Jahannama ka laakara, ko ɓe luttata poomaa adabaa. Nge bonii ruttorde!
